recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Do not add another Address examples table or duplicate nearby guidance; future country-specific address parts should remain extensions unless a new final work-group decision changes the core Address datatype.
issue_request: FHIR-3501 was Published with resolution Persuasive with Modification for the Initial_Draft Practitioner address concern. It asked for richer address modeling for country-specific structures, possible line-use clarification, and replacement of narrow postal-address wording; the final resolution was to add a table showing common examples of how addresses would be populated.
